# Project Phoenix v15.0: targeted REPLACE overrides for vanilla character_interactions.
# Generated from EU5 1.4.9 vanilla definitions; do not edit by hand.

# --- From in_game/common/character_interactions/D008_assign_despot.txt (1 block) ---
REPLACE:assign_despot = {
	message = yes
	on_own_nation = yes

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_or_had_tag = BYZ
			oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
			has_dlc = "d008_fate_of_the_phoenix"
		}
	} 

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6

	price = price:assign_despot_price

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ruler = yes
			oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes
			ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			is_alive = yes
			is_female = no
			NOT = { has_character_modifier = despot_modifier }
			has_dynasty = yes
			is_ruler = no
		}
		enabled = {
			is_adult = yes
			dynasty ?= scope:actor.ruler.dynasty
		}
	}

	effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { scope:actor = { oe_byz_imperial_honors_allowed = yes } }
            scope:recipient = {
                add_character_modifier = {
                    mode = add_and_extend
                    modifier = despot_modifier
                    years = -1
                }
            }
        }
    }

   ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			value = scope:recipient.total_abilities
			subtract = 250
		}

		add = {
			value = scope:actor.estate_satisfaction:nobles_estate
			# remap to -1 to 0
			subtract = 1

			# intensity
			multiply = 50
		}

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							is_general = yes
							is_admiral = yes
						}
					}
				}
				value = 30
			}
		}

		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = {
						OR = {
							has_trait_category = general
							has_trait_category = admiral
						}
					}
				}
				value = 30
			}
		}
    }
}

# --- From in_game/common/character_interactions/banish_character.txt (1 block) ---
REPLACE:banish_character = { 
	on_own_nation = yes
	message = yes

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			OR = {
				modifier:can_banish_characters = yes
				trigger_if = {	#Special for Korea
					limit = { has_variable = kor_mongol_aristocrats }
					var:kor_mongol_aristocrats > 0
				}
				has_variable = vij_tamil_rebellion
			}
		}
	}

	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 120

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			government_power >= 50
			stability >= 0
		}
	}
	
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
			is_alive = yes
			or = {
				is_religious_figure = no
				religious_figure != religious_figure:cardinal
			}
		}
		enabled = {
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			is_regent = no
			is_expedition_leader = no
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynasty = yes
					scope:actor = {
						ruler ?= { has_dynasty = yes }
					}
				}
				NOT = { dynasty = scope:actor.ruler.dynasty }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient scope:recipient = { NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes } } }

		scope:actor = {
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_ruler = yes } }
				add_prestige = ABDICATE_PRESTIGE_HIT
				add_government_power = ABDICATE_GOVERNMENT_POWER_HIT
			}
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_heir = yes } }
				add_prestige = DISINHERIT_PRESTIGE_HIT
			}
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_consort = yes } }
				add_prestige = REMOVE_CONSORT_PRESTIGE_HIT
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_extreme_penalty 
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_severe_penalty 
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty 
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_weak_penalty 
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character }
				add_government_power = var:has_banished_or_executed_character
			}
			custom_tooltip = increase_gov_power_cost_banished_character_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character } }
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character value = -2.5 days = 730 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp value = var:has_banished_or_executed_character }
					change_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp add = -2.5 }
					remove_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character value = var:has_banished_or_executed_character_temp days = 730 }
					remove_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp
				}
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:recipient = { has_variable = tamil_rebel_leader }
					}
					scope:recipient = { save_scope_as = target_character }
					trigger_event_silently = flavor_vij.1102
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			scope:actor = { 
				random_neighbor_country = { save_scope_as = target_country }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:target_country } }
					random_country = {
						limit = { within_diplomatic_range = scope:actor }
						save_scope_as = target_country
					}
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:target_country }
					move_country = scope:target_country
				}
				else = {
					kill_character_silently = {
						target = scope:recipient
						reason = vanished
					}
				}
			}
		}
	
        }
    }

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:recipient = { has_variable = kor_mongol_characters }
				}
				value = 100
			}
		}
		#The AI should not really have much reason to do this character interaction
		#As such, only a rudimentary logic is added for Korea to get rid of the Mongol aristocrats
	}
	
}	

# --- From in_game/common/character_interactions/execute_character.txt (1 block) ---
REPLACE:execute_character = { 
	on_own_nation = yes
	message = yes

	ai_tick = never

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			modifier:can_execute_characters = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			government_power >= 50
			stability > 0
		}
	}
	
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = character
		source = actor
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_character"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
			is_alive = yes
		}
		enabled = {
            NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes }
			is_ruler = no
			is_heir = no
			is_consort = no
			is_regent = no
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = execute_character_not_pretender_tt
				NOT = { has_variable = scope_pretender_var }
			}
			trigger_if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynasty = yes
					scope:actor = {
						ruler = { has_dynasty = yes }
					}
				}
				NOT = { dynasty = scope:actor.ruler.dynasty }
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient scope:recipient = { NOT = { oe_bells_protected_thinker = yes } } }

		scope:actor = {
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_ruler = yes } }
				add_prestige = ABDICATE_PRESTIGE_HIT
				add_government_power = ABDICATE_GOVERNMENT_POWER_HIT
			}
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_heir = yes } }
				add_prestige = DISINHERIT_PRESTIGE_HIT
			}
			if = {	#Should not happen, but in case it does
				limit = { scope:recipient = { is_consort = yes } }
				add_prestige = REMOVE_CONSORT_PRESTIGE_HIT
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:nobles_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_extreme_penalty
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:clergy_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:clergy_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_severe_penalty
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:burghers_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			}
			if = {
				limit = { scope:recipient = { has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate } }
				add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:peasants_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty }
				add_stability = stability_weak_penalty
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character }
				add_government_power = var:has_banished_or_executed_character
			}
			custom_tooltip = increase_gov_power_cost_executed_character_tt
			hidden_effect = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character } }
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character value = -5 days = 730 }
				}
				else = {
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp value = var:has_banished_or_executed_character }
					change_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp add = -5 }
					remove_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character
					set_variable = { name = has_banished_or_executed_character value = var:has_banished_or_executed_character_temp days = 730 }
					remove_variable = has_banished_or_executed_character_temp
				}
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = ruler }
				scope:actor = {
					kill_character = {
						target = scope:recipient
						reason = execution
						killer = ruler
					}
				}
			}
			else = {
				scope:actor = {
					kill_character = {
						target = scope:recipient
						reason = execution
					}
				}
			}
		}
	
        }
    }

	ai_will_do = {}
}
